commands.command: id -u; uname -srmo; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; if awk -F: '$1 == "contractor" {found=1; print $1 ":" $3 ":" $4 ":" $6 ":" $7} END {exit !found}' /etc/passwd; then chage -l contractor; else printf '%s\n' 'contractor account is absent'; fi
